reason: Complete D8 rung0: add both retained training populations, all historical development blocks, preregister count/cache calibration and actual generation replay. No native candidate or new final holdout.
reset: Fresh state, RoPE position0 and empty token cache per256input block; no EOS reset inside block; no injected BOS for likelihood. Read257stored IDs, score256targets shifted once.
split_scope: Tail withheld from THIS count-model calibration only. Entire dev population already selected historical neural checkpoint. Open development, never fresh final qualification.

ngram.name: fixed-discount interpolated Kneser-Ney with exact unpruned continuation counts and declared count pruning
ngram.train_boundary: reset between retained train stores; raw ngrams do not cross that file boundary
ngram.pruning: deterministic highest effective counts, lexical tie order, full removed mass backed off; disclose removed type count and removed effective-count mass per order plus retained byte cost
ngram.selection: Minimize first64blocks mean NLL; tie chooses lower grid index. Freeze D before remainder; fit counts only on train stores.

cache.selection: Using selected ngram D, minimize first64blocks mean NLL. Tie chooses lower grid index; freeze lambda for remaining912blocks. Shared-D comparison, not a joint18pair hyperparameter search.
cache.causality: At each position observe current input, then score next target. Target is observed only when it becomes the next input. Reset every256input block.
cache.distribution: normalized empirical token frequencies of observed prefix; mixture (1-lambda)*P_ngram+lambda*P_cache

generation.short_cycle: three consecutive repeats, periods1..4, smallestperiodfirst; EOS checked first
generation.replay_gate: generated IDs, decoded response and stop equal historical Rust outputs; full R4-gauge audit metadata not claimed equal
generation.golden_access: Historical outputs are read for comparison only after all continuations are produced.

comparison_reporting: Per-target records and per-block sums for all arms, separate Tune/comparison/fullmeans, no unmatched numerical A4 comparison. Same train sourcepopulation does not imply same sampled optimization exposure.
change_rule: Any evaluator change is versioned and independently reviewed prospectively. Preserve v1 and all original evidence.
